status: bounded author correction; independent review pending; not semantic acceptance
summary: Removed only the exact repeated boundary sentence from 17 ErrorCorrection fields, corrected the i014 wrong_4 diagnosis to match the signed-delta alternative, and added a case-specific retained-observation requirement for i016 so the existing traceability answer is supported.

actualDifferences.before: Keeping the transport type would couple scoring to partner field names; database names are also implementation details. If a partner code were itself the agreed durable domain identity, mapping that code would be reasonable.
actualDifferences.after: Keeping the transport type would couple scoring to partner field names; database names are also implementation details.

actualDifferences.before: Treating an unknown value as accepted bypasses the stated control; discarding it loses the evidence needed for quarantine review. If the domain explicitly defined an “unrecognized” terminal outcome, that could be mapped as such rather than quarantined.
actualDifferences.after: Treating an unknown value as accepted bypasses the stated control; discarding it loses the evidence needed for quarantine review.

actualDifferences.before: Persisting offsets as identity breaks annotations when a recording changes; the vendor response does not own editorial meaning. If annotations were defined against absolute media time and not stable segments, preserving offsets could be the domain contract.
actualDifferences.after: Persisting offsets as identity breaks annotations when a recording changes; the vendor response does not own editorial meaning.

actualDifferences.before: Using email as identity can merge or misaddress grants; dropping approval linkage prevents the stated audit. If the provider guaranteed a stable identifier that the domain had adopted, that identifier could be mapped directly.
actualDifferences.after: Using email as identity can merge or misaddress grants; dropping approval linkage prevents the stated audit.

actualDifferences.before: Choosing “latest” can seal different bytes from those the signer reviewed; retaining a lookup token alone loses the domain link. If the vendor token were the agreed immutable revision identifier, it could serve as the domain reference.
actualDifferences.after: Choosing “latest” can seal different bytes from those the signer reviewed; retaining a lookup token alone loses the domain link.

actualDifferences.before: Floating point and inferred currency can change the payable amount; dropping currency makes equal numeric amounts ambiguous. If every payout were contractually in one fixed currency, a currency-free amount could be justified by that explicit invariant.
actualDifferences.after: Floating point and inferred currency can change the payable amount; dropping currency makes equal numeric amounts ambiguous.

actualDifferences.before: Comparing unlike units can admit an over-limit reading; late conversion spreads vendor semantics into the domain. If the domain limit were also expressed in watt-hours and the serial were the agreed meter identity, direct mapping would work.
actualDifferences.after: Comparing unlike units can admit an over-limit reading; late conversion spreads vendor semantics into the domain.

actualDifferences.before: Provider strings make callers depend on vendor wording; defaulting unknown language alters caption meaning. If callers explicitly need provider-specific troubleshooting, a separate diagnostic field may expose that code.
actualDifferences.after: Provider strings make callers depend on vendor wording; defaulting unknown language alters caption meaning.

actualDifferences.before: Controller compensation adds an unrequested partial-state path; DTO-aware entities couple domain logic to transport shape. If the business explicitly allowed partial swaps, independent updates could be appropriate.
actualDifferences.after: Controller compensation adds an unrequested partial-state path; DTO-aware entities couple domain logic to transport shape.

actualDifferences.before: Overwriting silently violates the conflict contract; raw JSON parsing leaks transport shape into map behavior. If the domain specified a coordinate-level merge rule for mismatched revisions, that rule could be applied after mapping.
actualDifferences.after: Overwriting silently violates the conflict contract; raw JSON parsing leaks transport shape into map behavior.

actualDifferences.before: A fallback grants a different item without authorization; duplicating state rules creates a second policy owner. If the provider and campaign shared a governed code set, a direct enum mapping could be safe.
actualDifferences.after: A fallback grants a different item without authorization; duplicating state rules creates a second policy owner.

actualDifferences.before: Keeping vendor units on the entity spreads conversion; dropping the limit loses a dispatch constraint. If the domain itself used Fahrenheit and accepted carrier codes as identity, those conversions would be unnecessary.
actualDifferences.after: Keeping vendor units on the entity spreads conversion; dropping the limit loses a dispatch constraint.

actualDifferences.before: Absolute value turns a reversal into a repayment; losing the reference removes the stated duplicate check. If the bank contract represented reversals with a separate explicit event type, use that marker instead of amount sign.
actualDifferences.after: Absolute value turns a reversal into a repayment; losing the reference removes the stated duplicate check.

actualDifferences.before: Currency and reference alone do not preserve whether the event is a reversal.
actualDifferences.after: Storing a signed delta bypasses the distinct reversal operation and the positive-amount repayment allocation.

actualDifferences.before: Mapping timeout straight to forfeit ignores the live-state precondition; advancing first can publish an invalid bracket. If the tournament explicitly treated all platform timeouts as forfeits regardless of match state, that would change the domain contract.
actualDifferences.after: Mapping timeout straight to forfeit ignores the live-state precondition; advancing first can publish an invalid bracket.

before: Classification is evidence; refund eligibility is a distinct policy decision.
Refund eligibility is a separate policy decision.
after: Classification is evidence; refund eligibility is a distinct policy decision.
Refund eligibility is a separate policy decision.
The return record retains the scanner observation used to explain each refund-eligibility decision.

actualDifferences.before: The return policy evaluates the observed label and confidence without treating confidence as approval.
actualDifferences.after: The saved return retains the scanner observation, while the return policy separately evaluates eligibility.

actualDifferences.before: Confidence is not stated as approval, and combining classification with payment collapses distinct meanings. If the business explicitly authorized a calibrated score threshold as its refund rule, that threshold would need to be stated and owned.
actualDifferences.after: Confidence is not stated as approval, and combining classification with payment collapses distinct meanings.

actualDifferences.before: A mutable tag does not identify a reproducible input; a display title cannot recover missing lineage. If the “latest” tag were immutable by contract, it could be retained as the exact input identity.
actualDifferences.after: A mutable tag does not identify a reproducible input; a display title cannot recover missing lineage.

actualDifferences.before: Rendering raw transport markup leaks presentation policy; substituting current revision changes what the author reviewed. If markup itself were the agreed comment domain language, retaining it could be correct.
actualDifferences.after: Rendering raw transport markup leaks presentation policy; substituting current revision changes what the author reviewed.
